gloss:gloating.label: gloating
gloss:gloating.description: This means dwelling smugly on one's own success or others' misfortune.
gloss:gloating.decision: Roger 2026-09-08: cover the dark and light areas with plain traits member by member (no named axes); consolidated first-pass list at lines 1659-1673; check overlap with the named neighbour before adding and prefer the pair form where the antonym is a real word. gloss:grave.label: grave
gloss:grave.description: This means speaking with quiet seriousness and treating weighty matters with full attention.
gloss:grave.decision: NOT SEEDED: Ruling on the flag: duplicate of `solemn`, whose description opens 'being grave, serious, and dignified'. The only differentiator is the trigger (serious matters only), which vanishes on exactly the questions a flippant/grave pair would use, and 'giving serious matters their due weight' is the baseline rather than a pole (an absence of flippancy, not an opposite). DROPPED 2026-09-28 (Roger): rejection approved.

gloss:hopeful.label: hopeful
gloss:hopeful.description: This means feeling confident that good things will happen and that difficulties can be overcome.
gloss:hopeful.decision: NOT SEEDED: Agree with the writer: hopeful looks forward and in plain English is `optimistic` (already paired with pessimistic); the description is bent onto bitter's trigger (coming out of disappointment unsoured), which the word does not carry, and bitter's core is resentment over the past. DROPPED 2026-09-28 (Roger): rejection approved.

gloss:ingenuous.label: ingenuous
gloss:ingenuous.description: This means speaking one's mind openly without calculation or hidden intent.
gloss:ingenuous.decision: NOT SEEDED: Ruling on the flag: agree with the writer. Ingenuous means innocent and artless (the `guileless`/`naive` territory), not 'without irony'; the un-wry pole is earnest/sincere, and `earnest` already exists as the clean partner of `sardonic`. DROPPED 2026-09-28 (Roger): rejection approved.

gloss:left_brained.label: left-brained
gloss:left_brained.description: This means thinking through problems step by step using logic and analysis rather than intuition or creative leaps.
gloss:left_brained.decision: Optional suggestion, accepted 2026-09-08 NOT SEEDED: Criterion (c): in everyday English 'left-brained' means exactly the bundle analytical + logical + methodical, so an honest description can only restate three seeded traits and the vector would sit on top of them (the queue itself expects a low yield). gloss:literalist.label: literalist

DROPPED 2026-09-28 (Roger): rejection approved.

DROPPED 2026-09-28 (Roger): rejection approved.

gloss:modern.label: modern
